scenario.title: Team Offsite
scenario.tagline: Book a venue for 30 engineers next Friday.
scenario.brief: Book a venue for a one-day offsite next Friday for 30 engineers. We need catering for everyone and fast Wi-Fi (500 Mbps or better) because we are demoing live. Flexible cancellation and a well-rated venue are a plus.

events.message: We can showcase your team vibe in this canal-side loft for $1,750. Let’s create something beautiful together! ✨

The space costs $2,250. It is solid and ready for work. No extras.
